name: refactor-shop-structural-evidence
description: A controlled Go refactor fixture with manually reviewable structural ground truth.
limitations: This suite measures deterministic evidence retrieval, process output, and elapsed time; it is not an end-to-end coding-agent or token-cost benchmark.
The fixture is intentionally small and controlled. Results do not predict behavior on every repository.
Text-search workflows are representative baselines, not claims about the full capabilities of ripgrep or gopls.

scenarios.title: Find implicit interface implementations
scenarios.question: Which concrete types satisfy ProductRepository without declaring that relationship?

demo.finding: Both implicit implementations are returned from the type-checked graph.

scenarios.title: Trace an interface-dispatched call
scenarios.question: Which function calls ProductRepository.Save through an interface value?

evidence.description: The result retains the repository.Save call site

demo.finding: The interface-qualified query resolves the concrete dispatch target and preserves the source call site.

scenarios.title: Gather change context in one workflow
scenarios.question: What source, callers, dependencies, and tests should be inspected before changing ReserveStock?

demo.finding: One response bundles the implementation, caller, error dependency, and mapped test.

scenarios.title: Extract one exact source block
scenarios.question: What is the complete ReserveStock implementation without reading neighboring code?

evidence.description: The complete ReserveStock source is returned

demo.finding: The AST range stops at the function boundary instead of spilling into the next declaration.
